title: Critical Rails Flaw Lets Attackers Write Server Files via Crafted ImageMagick Uploads
summary_en: A critical flaw in Ruby on Rails could allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on an app's server by uploading a crafted file if the app processes uploads using ImageMagick.
